courses.title: Resiliency Through Change and Grief with Lama Rod in Australia
courses.description: Lama Rod Owens's first teaching visit to Australia, at the Abbotsford Convent in Melbourne: a weekend of meditation, breathwork, gentle movement, grief practice and teachings on Ma Tara, in person or by livestream. A separate gathering on the Friday is for First Nations people and people of colour.

free_resources.title: Medicine Buddha: A Weekly Gathering with Lama Rod
free_resources.description: A free weekly Monday evening practice on Zoom in which Lama Rod Owens and fellow practitioners chant and visualise the Medicine Buddha. The page also links a recording archive, mantra instructions and an introductory practice text.
